prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of an open black-paper scrapbook on a concrete loft desk. Overhead neon signage outside the window casts a faint magenta-teal glow on the right side of the spread, and a small portable lamp in the upper left creates a warm pool. The black paper swallows light except where white gel pen and metallic ink catch it.

Subject:
A music-fan's concert scrapbook spread. The left page is a dense collage of concert wristbands, torn flyer edges, and setlist scraps glued in tilted angles with strong rubber cement halos. A ballpoint-drawn amplifier doodle spills along the margin. The right page is covered in silver gel pen handwriting that zigzags across the dark surface, and a stack of metallic-glitter-dotted photo corners holds two black-and-white strip-photo fragments.

Important details:
The rubber cement halos must be physical — slightly yellowed, with uneven edges. White and silver ink on black paper must show pen pressure variance: wider strokes where the hand pressed harder. Wristbands have velcro texture. The neon glow on the right must fade organically, not as a flat overlay. Every tilted element has its own small drop shadow.

Use case:
Independent single image in the Scrapbook Variations package, representing the music-fan voice.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no band names, no vector edges, no uniform glow, no HDR, no symmetry, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
title: Concert Stub Collage
description: A black-paper scrapbook spread layered with concert wristbands, torn flyer edges, and silver gel-pen handwriting.
